issues: 定格后近 70 帧画面完全静止，只剩一张卡居中在纯黑里，没有任何后续信息
卡面是灰阶占位骨架（灰条 + 灰圆），定格成近满幅后反而更显空洞
背景是死平纯黑，没有光源与空间，星芒和卡片之间缺少"光变出卡"的联系
构图左右各空出约 500px 黑边，画面没有层级与视觉重心之外的内容
changes: look 换为 midnight：闪光期舞台压暗让星芒成为唯一光源，卡落定时主光与卡后背光一起亮起，浮尘缓慢漂移
卡面重做为深海军蓝「Founders Pass」邀请卡：四芒星徽记 + 同心细环 + 交叉针线复刻开场星芒，58px 大字标题、mono 票根行，徽记区全息箔随自旋角流光、定格即冻结
构图改为左卡右文：闪光点 = 落点（画面左 1/3），卡向右上荡出一道弧线再回到原点定格；右侧 132px 标题「Doors open / Nov 4.」与副文在定格后逐行揭示
保留用户定值的手法内核（9f 星芒转 90°、slow-in→弹射→减速弧线、13 圈对角自旋衰减、零回弹硬定格），飞行中卡带蓝色辉光被运动模糊拖成光尾
落定瞬间加一圈与卡同形的光脉冲外扩淡出，8f 后单次 sheen 扫光裁进圆角；时长 126→156f，最后 1.7s 是一张完整邀请海报
issuesEn: After the freeze nearly 70 frames are completely static: one card centred on pure black with nothing else to read
The card face is a grey placeholder skeleton (grey bars and a grey circle), which looks emptier once it fills the frame
Flat pure-black background with no light source or depth; nothing ties the star flash to the card it produces
About 500px of black on each side; the frame has no hierarchy beyond the single card
changesEn: Look switched to midnight: the stage is held dark during the flash so the star is the only light, then the key light and a backlight bloom as the card lands, with slow drifting dust

Card rebuilt as a deep-navy "Founders Pass" invitation: four-point star emblem with fine rings and crossed needles echoing the opening flare, 58px headline, mono ticket stub, and a holographic foil that shifts with spin angle and freezes on landing

Composition is now card-left, copy-right: the flash point is the landing point, the card swings out in an arc to the upper right and returns to freeze; a 132px headline "Doors open / Nov 4." and subline reveal line by line after the freeze

Kept the user-tuned core (9f star flash rotating 90deg, slow-in > burst > decelerating arc, 13 diagonal spins with decay, zero-bounce hard freeze); the card carries a blue glow in flight that motion blur smears into a light trail
On landing a card-shaped light pulse expands and fades, followed 8f later by one sheen clipped to the rounded corners; duration 126 to 156f, ending on a complete invitation poster
